about: Tripo Studio projects of the user (studio.tripo3d.ai, workspace list newest first, 2026-09-28). key = folder under SourceArt/Tripo; t2 = the /Game/SaskartaGaea/Environment/Tripo02/SM_T2_<t2> slot in Tools/World/setdress_catalog.py TRIPO2; real_size_m = the planned size (x, y, z) the import scale targets; verdict use = import, review = look first.
